description: ARM assembly source code for BoringSSL's optimized AES implementation, including AES encryption/decryption cores, key schedule, and key conversion functions, with specific focus on ARMv7 architecture and Neon instructions.

methods.name: _vpaes_preheat
methods.description: Initializes constants and tables for AES operations.

methods.name: _vpaes_encrypt_core
methods.description: Performs AES encryption on a block.

methods.name: _vpaes_decrypt_core
methods.description: Performs AES decryption on a block.

methods.name: _vpaes_schedule_transform
methods.description: Applies linear transform to AES key.

methods.name: _vpaes_schedule_mangle
methods.description: Transforms key for last round, with different behavior for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: vpaes_encrypt
methods.description: Public function to encrypt a block with AES.

methods.name: vpaes_decrypt
methods.description: Public function to decrypt a block with AES.

methods.name: vpaes_set_encrypt_key
methods.description: Sets up AES encryption key schedule.

methods.name: vpaes_set_decrypt_key
methods.description: Sets up AES decryption key schedule.

methods.name: vpaes_encrypt_key_to_bsaes
methods.description: Converts VPAES key schedule to BSAES format.

methods.name: vpaes_decrypt_key_to_bsaes
methods.description: Converts BSAES key schedule to VPAES format.

methods.name: vpaes_ctr32_encrypt_blocks
methods.description: Encrypts multiple blocks in CTR mode.
